## Summary

What changed and why, in a few sentences. Link the issue with `Closes #N`.

## Verification

The commands you ran and their results (`npm run verify` runs lint, typecheck, tests, and the
production build). For UI changes, describe what you tried in the browser, including keyboard use
and a 320 px-wide screen.

## Notes for reviewers

Contracts touched (see `.github/copilot-instructions.md`), schema changes, trade-offs, and
anything the automated review should look at first.
